executionRules.allRects: ABSOLUTE logicalpx504×894; parent-local conversion happens only when root executes native UI.
executionRules.parentOrder: Each parent key already exists. Roots have parent null. Native screen is family.name, plain/button root is a distinct element.
executionRules.panel: skin is existing source mirror path, native9frame. Screen/action array is recipe, never write it into design model.
executionRules.button: text is native child label, skin contains no words, default native press tint=true. Explicit text/image descendants forward input to button.
executionRules.modal: standalone. No behindpage or fake game entry buttons. 3D source area uses plain+3D only.
executionRules.input: No unsupported input op. inputControlsRequired tells root where native editable control must be configured; preview text cannot remain fake input at completion.
executionRules.unknown: No unseen numbers/copied full source screenshot/invented action result. Notes distinguish source observation from native visual replacements.
